mechanism_findings.identifiability: The full-strength total-action gauge reconstructed the executed additive action within tolerance in every paired cell.
mechanism_findings.frequency_alignment: The EMA gauge reduced upper high-frequency power but increased lower low-frequency drift relative to the registered joint-band comparator in every paired cell.
mechanism_findings.reward: The feasibility-first constrained checkpoint lost the preregistered reward floor in all three HalfCheetah optimizer replicates.
mechanism_findings.constraint_learning: Primal-dual training improved latent frequency merit over the gauge-only control in five of nine cells, below the frozen six-cell and per-environment gate.
mechanism_findings.decision: Do not expand this EMA-gauge training protocol. Replace its temporal operator with an audit-aligned causal complementary projection and preserve an explicit reward floor during checkpoint selection.
